macro_theme: Drainage Modeling Gaps and Water Management Research Needs
macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses research gaps, validation challenges, and modeling advances across subsurface and tile drainage systems, spanning flow dynamics, soil salinity leaching, controlled drainage and irrigation management, and watershed-scale practices. It unifies calls for future study and improved modeling frameworks needed to optimize drainage water management from field to watershed scales.
member_themes: Data and Experimental Validation Needs; Subsurface Drainage Flow Modeling Research Gaps; Controlled Drainage and Irrigation Water Management; Watershed Modeling for Drainage Management; Tile Drainage Research Gaps and Modeling Needs; Subsurface Drainage for Soil Salt Leaching

macro_theme: Research Gaps and Nutrient Loss Management
macro_description: This umbrella theme spans identified deficiencies in long-term drainage research alongside forward-looking priorities for managing nutrient—particularly nitrate—losses through improved crop systems, soil practices, and water management strategies. It unifies calls for future investigation across organic soils, cover crop integration, and drainage system design with actionable management approaches to reduce leaching and improve system-level outcomes.
member_themes: Future Research and Management Practices Needed; Future Research Needs for Crop-Drainage Systems; Reducing Nitrate Losses via Management; Long-Term Organic Soil Drainage Research Gaps

macro_description: This umbrella theme spans the design, performance evaluation, and knowledge gaps of woodchip bioreactors used for nitrate removal from tile drainage, as well as bioaugmentation strategies to enhance their denitrification efficiency. Together, the sub-themes address both foundational research needs and targeted biological interventions within the woodchip bioreactor system.
member_themes: Bioreactor Design and Research Gaps; Bioaugmentation to Enhance Woodchip Bioreactor Denitrification

macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses research focused on testing, calibrating, and validating drainage models against field-collected data across a range of site conditions and experimental designs. It covers the development and refinement of governing equations and simulation frameworks to ensure model outputs reliably reflect real-world tile drainage behavior.

macro_theme: Longitudinal Data Gaps and Monitoring Imperatives
macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses the recognized need for extended observational records and sustained research investment in tile drainage systems, reflecting calls across the literature for longer study durations, additional monitoring infrastructure, and richer datasets to draw reliable conclusions. It spans sub-themes centered on the insufficiency of short-term data, the value of multi-year field measurements, and explicit recommendations for future monitoring efforts.
